hooks.command: PY="$(command -v python 2>/dev/null || command -v python3 2>/dev/null)"; [ -n "$PY" ] && "$PY" "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/scripts/agent_done_gate.py" --hook claude || true
hooks.statusMessage: Agent done gate: has this work landed?

hooks.command: p=$(printf '%s' "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" | tr '\' '/'); case "$p" in */.claude/agents/*|*/.claude/commands/*|*/.claude/skills/*|*/.agents/agents/*|*/.agents/commands/*|*/.agents/skills/*) PY="$(command -v python 2>/dev/null || command -v python3 2>/dev/null)"; [ -n "$PY" ] && "$PY" "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/scripts/ci/sync_agents_dir.py" --quiet ;; esac

case "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" in */docs/*|docs/*) PY="$(command -v python 2>/dev/null || command -v python3 2>/dev/null)"; [ -n "$PY" ] && "$PY" "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/scripts/ci/docs_privacy_scan.py" "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" ;; esac
